text:
elaine (supply ops): APAC cluster down to 12 H100s, vendor offered partial release of 8 units from FRA warehouse. PO: PO-90872. Can we accept split shipment? Need customs bond waiver for early release. @tariq thoughts?

tariq (logistics): Can confirm customs bond waiver is possible but adds ~$1.5k in brokerage unless vendor covers. Need AWB & commercial invoice to try waiver.

mike (infra): If we get 8 now we can hot-swap into staging pool — latency SLOs fine. Prefer EU->APAC courier vs sea. :thumbsup:

jonah (eng): Quick Q — are these factory-sealed or vendor pre-inspected? What's DOA risk? Vendor says 'random QC', not full test.

tariq (logistics): Vendor (HyperDrive Logistics) proposing depot repair option: either RMA back to vendor repair in EU or local depot swap in SG. Depot swap cost would be $750/unit if we elect that path. Vendor covers return freight if DOA within 30 days.

SupplyBot: SupplyBot: AWB created: HD1234567890. ETA SG: 2026-04-08. Status: customs_pending.

nina (finance): If vendor won't waive brokerage, finance can approve up to $2k expedite/broker fee with a PO amendment, but need justification (cluster-health SLA impact).

elaine (supply ops): Short decision options: 1) Accept split shipment + pay broker fee (finance ok) 2) Push vendor to cover brokerage for early release 3) Delay until full allocation ships. Vote?

mike (infra): 1) Accept split. We need units now. I'll prep staging + hot-swap runbook. @jonah can you schedule smoke tests?

jonah (eng): Got it. Scheduling tonight; will include rollback commands and test checklist. If DOA > 1 we escalate to vendor RMAs.

tariq (logistics): I'll push vendor for vendor-paid brokerage; if they refuse we'll accept and push invoice through PO addendum. Opening RMA placeholder in case: RMA-2026-309.

SupplyBot: SupplyBot: RMA placeholder created: RMA-2026-309. Vendor SLA: 21 days repair. Depot-swap option flagged.

elaine (supply ops): OK proceeding with split release under option 1 for now. @nina please update PO and approve expedite up to $2k. I'll confirm AWB docs and customs paperwork with HyperDrive.

nina (finance): Approved. Please cc finance on the vendor invoice and attach the customs invoice when available.

elaine (supply ops): :thumbsup: Thanks — will update thread once AWB clears customs or if vendor agrees to cover brokerage.
